nodes.label: Remote GPU Deploy Skill
nodes.content: Skill document for deploying ML models (Wav2Lip, MuseTalk, LatentSync, JoyVASA, V-Express, EchoMimic, AniPortrait, Hallo2) to remote GPU servers (AutoDL/SeetaCloud) in network-constrained environments. Covers server inventory (old GTX 1080 Ti ×8 server, RTX 4080 eval server), weight download strategies (hf-mirror.com, proxy, local+SCP), conda environment management patterns (greenfield creation, GraalPy trap, pip upgrade cascade, ONNX Runtime CUDA), common code patches (torch.load weights_only, path replace bug, batch inference template), model compatibility matrix with VRAM/CUDA/PyTorch requirements, and SyncNet evaluation pipeline integration.

nodes.label: SyncNet Evaluation
nodes.content: Audio-visual lip-sync quality evaluation framework based on SyncNet model. Measures SyncC (confidence, higher=better) and SyncD (L2 distance between audio-video embeddings, lower=better). Used as primary metric for evaluating TTS model quality in lip-sync applications.

nodes.label: Remote GPU Deployment Workflow
nodes.content: Workflow for deploying ML lip-sync models to remote GPU servers (AutoDL/SeetaCloud) with limited HuggingFace access. Three-tier weight download strategy (hf-mirror.com > proxy > local+SCP). Conda environment management with critical traps: GraalPy resolution, pip upgrade cascades, ONNX Runtime CUDA provider, PyTorch 2.6+ weights_only default. Support for model evaluation via SyncNet on eval server.

nodes.label: Conda Environment Management
nodes.content: Patterns for creating and reusing conda environments on remote GPU servers. Greenfield creation: conda create with pytorch/torchaudio/pytorch-cuda channels. Critical traps: GraalPy vs CPython resolution, pip upgrade cascades silently upgrading torch, onnxruntime-gpu needed for CUDA providers, PyTorch 2.6+ torch.load defaults to weights_only=True breaking legacy checkpoints. Environment reuse strategy to avoid dependency conflicts.

nodes.label: Weight Download Strategy
nodes.content: Ordered reliability strategy for downloading model weights on network-constrained GPU servers: (1) hf-mirror.com via wget, no proxy needed, fastest for small files; (2) proxy via source /etc/network_turbo, unstable for large files; (3) local download + SCP with sshpass, most reliable for files >1GB.

nodes.label: Lip-Sync Model Compatibility Matrix
nodes.content: Compatibility reference for 8 lip-sync models across VRAM, CUDA, and PyTorch constraints: Wav2Lip (4GB, CUDA 11.x, PyTorch 2.0.1, TorchScript→state_dict), MuseTalk 1.5 (8GB, CUDA 11.x, vae_type=v15), LatentSync (4GB, CUDA 12.x, PyTorch 2.6, OOM at 512×512 on old GPU), JoyVASA (3GB, CUDA 12.x, PyTorch 2.4.1, fastest 23s/video), V-Express (9GB, CUDA 12.x, PyTorch 2.6, slow 6min/video, kps pre-extraction), EchoMimic (11GB, CUDA 12.x, abandoned), AniPortrait (>11GB, OOM on 1080 Ti), Hallo2 (24GB, CUDA 11.8, PyTorch 2.2.2, English only).

nodes.label: Common Code Patch Patterns
nodes.content: Recurring fixes for lip-sync model inference: (1) torch.load weights_only patch for PyTorch ≥2.6 with sed replacement then keyword argument fix; (2) str.replace path bug causing extension corruption fixed with pathlib; (3) batch inference script template with skip-existing logic and exit code logging.

nodes.label: GTX 1080 Ti Server (Old)
nodes.content: Lip-sync inference server with 8× GTX 1080 Ti (11GB, CUDA 11.4 max), PyTorch max 2.0.1+cu118. Works with Wav2Lip and MuseTalk 1.5. Disk paths: /data/wjj/tfg_models/, /data/wjj/tfg_exp/. SSH: sshpass on port 1986 at 10.1.114.114.

nodes.label: RTX 4080 Eval Server
nodes.content: SyncNet evaluation and historical runs server with RTX 4080 SUPER (32GB). SyncNet conda env: /root/autodl-tmp/envs/syncnet. Repo: /root/autodl-tmp/repos/tts-exp. Runs directory: runs/tfg_*. SSH: sshpass on port 20398 at connect.westd.seetacloud.com.

nodes.label: Wav2Lip Model
nodes.content: Lip-sync model: 4GB VRAM minimum, CUDA 11.x, PyTorch 2.0.1, requires TorchScript→state_dict conversion. Compatible with old GTX 1080 Ti server.

nodes.label: MuseTalk 1.5 Model
nodes.content: Lip-sync model: 8GB VRAM minimum, CUDA 11.x, PyTorch 2.0.1, uses vae_type=v15 parameter. Compatible with old GTX 1080 Ti server.

nodes.label: LatentSync Model
nodes.content: Lip-sync model: 4GB VRAM minimum, CUDA 12.x, PyTorch 2.6.0. OOM at 512×512 resolution on old GPU (GTX 1080 Ti). Requires newer GPU.

nodes.label: JoyVASA Model
nodes.content: Lip-sync model: 3GB VRAM minimum, CUDA 12.x, PyTorch 2.4.1. Fastest inference at 23 seconds per video.

nodes.label: V-Express Model
nodes.content: Lip-sync model: 9GB VRAM minimum, CUDA 12.x, PyTorch 2.6.0. Slow inference at 6 minutes per video. Requires kps (keypoints) pre-extraction.

nodes.label: EchoMimic Model
nodes.content: Lip-sync model: 11GB VRAM minimum, CUDA 12.x. Abandoned due to slow inference speed and high VRAM requirements.

nodes.label: AniPortrait Model
nodes.content: Lip-sync model: >11GB VRAM required, CUDA 12.x. OOM on GTX 1080 Ti (11GB limit). Incompatible with old server.

nodes.label: Hallo2 Model
nodes.content: Lip-sync model: 24GB VRAM minimum, CUDA 11.8 only, PyTorch 2.2.2. English language only. Requires high-end GPU.
